title: QCLI-445 follow-up: correct the question store conflict wording and close six non-blocking review findings
description:
Non-blocking DEC-183 round-2 findings on the QCLI-445 question family. One PR, ahead of QCLI-502.

(3) EXIT-CODE WORDING IS WRONG FOR THE COMMON RACE. Two concurrent `answer Q-1`: the loser takes the lock normally, re-reads, sees the record already moved and gets exit 6 question_not_open -- NOT exit 5. Exit 5 only happens when the lock wait expires. Fix the prose at src/adapters/questions/local-question-repository.ts:38-42, src/application/questions/questions.ts:30-32, src/ports/questions.ts:18-21 and CHANGELOG.md:24-27 to: the loser never overwrites -- it reports question_not_open (exit 6) when the record already moved, or a store conflict (exit 5) when the lock wait expires.

(4) command-help.ts:19 promises `--fields` for `question list`/`question view`, which reject it (`quest question list --fields id` exits 2). Fix the sentence to match reality. `search` has the same mismatch and is in scope.

(2) Add a guard test: after `answer` is refused with question_not_open, assert `.quest/questions/.write.lock` is gone and a following `ask` succeeds.

(6) Question records lack the trailing newline every other record writer adds (src/adapters/records/codec.ts:40). Add it.

(7) The QCLI-445 finalSummary contradicts itself on the minimum option count; DEC-190s 2-4 is the live rule. Correct the record.

(5) The sweep test is bounded at 15s (test/cli-tracker-process.test.ts:1340 and :1360) and dev was already at ~14.7s. Measure the run on dev with #615 in; if it is within 10% of the bound, raise both to 30s as at :510.
plan: 1. Fix the conflict/exit-code wording at the four cited sites.
2. Fix the --fields promise in command-help.ts for question list/view and search.
3. Add the guard test: after a refused answer, the lock is released and a following ask succeeds.
4. Add the trailing newline to question records.
5. Correct the QCLI-445 finalSummary minimum-options contradiction.
6. Measure the sweep on dev and raise the bound to 30s only if within 10% of it.
7. Full check, then PR into dev.
implementationNotes:
All six items addressed on this branch.

(3) Exit-code wording corrected at the four sites (local-question-repository.ts, questions.ts, ports/questions.ts, CHANGELOG.md): the loser of a concurrent answer or withdraw never overwrites -- it reports question_not_open (exit 6) when the record already moved, or a store conflict (exit 5) only when the lock wait expires. A concurrent ask's loser reports a store conflict (exit 5) too.

(4) The manifest help sentence no longer claims --fields for question list/view or search: --fields projection is offered only on task list and task view, which is exactly what the CLI accepts (verified against the manifest).

(2) A guard test asserts .quest/questions/.write.lock is gone after an answer refused with question_not_open, and that a following ask succeeds.

(6) encodeAuthoredRecord now newline-terminates the bytes, so question records end like planning.json and the task store; a test asserts the file ends with a newline.

(7) The QCLI-445 finalSummary's minimum-options contradiction is corrected: DEC-190's 2 to 4 options with a required --recommend is the live rule.

(5) MEASURED, so no change: on dev with #615 in, 9 isolated runs of the two sweep tests peaked at 12.11s against the 15s bound -- 80.7% of it, i.e. NOT within 10% -- so the bound stays 15s. The samples ranged 6.62 to 12.11s.
finalSummary:
The six non-blocking DEC-183 round-2 findings on the QCLI-445 question family, all addressed.

(3) Conflict wording corrected at the four cited sites: the loser of a concurrent answer or withdraw never overwrites -- it reports question_not_open (exit 6) when the record already moved, or a store conflict (exit 5) only when the lock wait expires.
(4) The manifest help no longer promises --fields on question list/view or on search; only task list and task view accept it, matching the CLI.
(2) A guard test asserts .quest/questions/.write.lock is gone after an answer refused with question_not_open, and that a following ask succeeds.
(6) encodeAuthoredRecord now newline-terminates, so a question record ends like every other record the store writes; a test asserts it.
(7) The QCLI-445 finalSummary's minimum-options contradiction is corrected: DEC-190's 2 to 4 options with a required --recommend is the live rule.
(5) MEASURED, no change: on dev with #615 in, 9 isolated runs of the two sweep tests peaked at 12.11s against the 15s bound (80.7%, not within 10%), so the bound stays 15s.

Verified: typecheck, lint, format:check and layer:check clean; contract, domain, question and workspaces suites 176/176; tracker-process 28/28; question suite 14/14.
